test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum of money was invested at 10% interest per year, compounded half-yearly for 18 months. If the amount payable on maturity was Rs. 83,349, what was the sum invested?
solution:
Given:

The sum invested at 10%

The sum invested compounded half yearly for 18 months

The amount payable on maturity was Rs. 83349

Formula used:

C.I. = P(1+ (R)/(100))^T

where C.I.= Amount payable on maturity

P= Amount invested or Principle

R= Rate of interest

T= Time Period

Calculation:

When the amount is invested for compounded half yearly, then the time period got doubled and rate of interest got halved

Time period= 18 mon x 2 = 36mon or 3 years

New rate of interest= 10% / 2 = 5%

According to the formula,

⇒ C.I = P(1+ (R)/(100))^T 

⇒ 83349=P(1+(5)/(100))³ 

⇒ 83349=P(1+(1)/(20))³

 ⇒ 83349=P×(21)/(20)×(21)/(20)×(21)/(20)

⇒ 83349×(20)/(21)×(20)/(21)×(20)/(21)=P 

⇒ 9 × 8000 = 72000

**T**he amount invested for 18 months is Rs. 72,000
